{{Top|leg}}
'''Pantoran plate specials''' were a set of meals and dishes served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] which were known for being cheaper than other meals at the diner. It contained three sections on the menu, breakfast specials, daily soups, and lunch specials. They were named for the [[Pantoran/Legends|Pantoran]] [[Species/Legends|species]].

{{Food-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Pantoran plate special are a reference to real life [[Wikipedia:Blue-plate special|blue plate specials]] as well as [[George Lucas]]'s blue skinned Pantoran character [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]]. They were originally to be called [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] plate specials, the original species given to Papanoida, but this was changed after [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]] episode [[Trespass]] retconned this.
